substance.statement: States the ADR's lane code backend decision: a lane table may declare code_backend, it must name one of the lane's backends, and the tracked profile declares [lane.deep] code_backend = omen-dense-27b.
Explains _candidates in hearth/localwork/service.py: for a non-delivery submission on a lane with more than one backend it returns the code backend, unpooled, with the choice by lane_code_backend.
Quotes the refusal raised when the lane has no code_backend: 'pooled code work is unsupported: no code-qualification source; a delivery brief is required'.
Quotes the validation error 'code_backend must name one of the lane's backends' and says where in service.py it is raised.
States what _candidates does on a retry (existing is not None): the recorded provider is kept and the choice is by recorded.
Cites only the ADR and hearth/localwork/service.py, and does not describe parts of service.py outside _candidates and the code_backend validation.
